checkout_url_fix.argument: active.id from the useOrganizations() seam the panel already destructures at :68, hoisted as `const activeId = active?.id ?? null;` so the effect reads a primitive
checkout_url_fix.null_branch: The existing CheckoutState 'failed' member, derived purely at the `checkout` computation (:79-80) rather than set in the effect body, because react-hooks/set-state-in-effect rejects that and the panel's docstring forbids any branch rendering an anchor whose href is unresolved. CheckoutState's `href` exists only on 'ready', so TypeScript already forbids the alternative and checkoutUrl('') is the banned empty destination. No new state member. The failed branch already renders checkoutFailed copy, a Tentar novamente button and no anchor; retry re-derives to failed, which costs nothing.
checkout_url_fix.dep_array: [activeId, attempt, client]. The primitive id and not the `active` object, because useOrganizations() memoizes its value but object identity still moves on every token re-application and a re-run would fire a fresh Hub discovery fetch on the operator's error screen. The file's own comment forbids a ref-based 'already fetched' guard because it would break the retry, so the dep array is the only place this can be solved. exhaustive-deps is satisfied since the effect reads activeId and nothing else off the seam.

apps/web/src/auth/__tests__/react.test.tsx: the literal at :212 (void client.checkoutUrl('sales.core')) and at :2062 (toHaveBeenCalledWith('sales.core')) both become 'workspace-alpha', the id the surrounding test already mints through profileToken('Alpha', undefined, 'workspace-alpha').
